description: A guide's default caption comes from one of **three** formatters, and `config.fieldTitle` picks which: `switch (config.fieldTitle) { case 'plain': return fieldDef.field; case 'functional': return functionalTitleFormatter(fieldDef); default: return verbalTitleFormatter(fieldDef, config); }`. Only the verbal one was implemented here, so a theme asking for either of the others was answered with prose it had not asked for — `Mean of v` where the chart wanted `v`. The key itself reaches the emitted configuration either way, Vega having no use for it and upstream passing it through regardless, which is why a sweep over what is emitted could not see this at all. `plain` is the bare column name whatever was done to it: a mean, a bucketed month, a bin and an argmax all read `v` or `t` here, where the verbal formatter would announce each derivation. The last panel is the one that gives nothing: a **count** has no field, so `plain` returns undefined and the axis carries no title at all — not the configured count title, which only the verbal formatter reaches.
